changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0035. Gym CRM leads, follow-ups, and trials. A lead is not a member and a trial is not an attendance visit. Index review: PK on each Id; IX_Leads_TenantId_Status serves the lead list and status filter; IX_Leads_TenantId_Mobile serves duplicate detection by exact mobile; IX_Leads_TenantId_AssignedUserId serves the salesperson filter and is limited to assigned rows; IX_LeadFollowUps_TenantId_ScheduledAt serves today, overdue, and upcoming queues for open follow-ups; IX_LeadTrials_LeadId serves a lead's trial history. Performance note: every list index leads with TenantId so one gym does not scan another gym's CRM.

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0036. Enable GYM_CRM on business plans and grant CRM permissions to owner, manager, and a limited receptionist set. Index review: no new indexes; inserts use UX_FeatureDefinitions_Code, UX_PlanFeatures_PlanId_FeatureCode, UX_Permissions_Code, and PK_RolePermissions. Performance note: the catalog write is a fixed set of rows.
